basic_info.description: This charming 3-level, 4-bedroom, 1-bathroom home at 1475 Shafter Ave in San Francisco's Bayview neighborhood is a fantastic opportunity to turn a gem into your dream home. This 840 sq. ft. property features classic wood shingle exteriors, a cozy brick fireplace, and a spacious backyard perfect for outdoor living. Enjoy the convenience of local stores, public transportation, and scenic views, all while investing in a property that will last you a lifetime.
